Container.Name: Lire
Container.Overview: Self-hosted manga and comics manager that connects Prowlarr, qBittorrent and Kavita.
Container.Requires: Configure the required credentials and service URLs before starting Lire.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Lire web interface port

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Persistent application state

Config.Name: Manga Library
Config.Description: Same host folder used by qBittorrent and Kavita

Config.Name: Comics Library
Config.Description: Same host folder used by qBittorrent and Kavita

Config.Name: Manga Other Languages
Config.Description: Sibling folder for releases in other languages

Config.Name: Comics Other Languages
Config.Description: Sibling folder for releases in other languages

Config.Name: Lire Admin Password
Config.Description: Required initial administrator password

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Required secret used to sign session cookies; generate a random value

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Initial administrator username

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone

Config.Name: Prowlarr URL
Config.Description: Reachable Prowlarr URL, for example http://UNRAID-IP:9696

Config.Name: Prowlarr API Key
Config.Description: API key from Prowlarr

Config.Name: Prowlarr Categories
Config.Description: Newznab categories searched

Config.Name: Manga Categories
Config.Description: Categories identifying manga releases

Config.Name: Comics Categories
Config.Description: Categories identifying comics releases

Config.Name: Pack Images
Config.Description: Pack loose images into CBZ files

Config.Name: Follow Interval Hours
Config.Description: Hours between checks for followed series

Config.Name: Release Language
Config.Description: Default release language: fr, en, ja, es, it or de

Config.Name: qBittorrent URL
Config.Description: Reachable qBittorrent Web UI URL

Config.Name: qBittorrent Username
Config.Description: qBittorrent Web UI username

Config.Name: qBittorrent Password
Config.Description: qBittorrent Web UI password

Config.Name: qBittorrent Manga Save Root
Config.Description: Manga save path as seen inside qBittorrent; map it to the same host folder as Lire

Config.Name: qBittorrent Comics Save Root
Config.Description: Comics save path as seen inside qBittorrent; map it to the same host folder as Lire

Config.Name: Kavita URL
Config.Description: Reachable Kavita URL, including its port

Config.Name: Kavita API Key
Config.Description: API key from Kavita third-party clients settings

Config.Name: Kavita Public URL
Config.Description: Public address readers use to access Kavita

Config.Name: Kavita Manga Library Name
Config.Description: Existing Kavita manga library name

Config.Name: Kavita Manga Root
Config.Description: Manga path as seen inside Kavita; must point to the same host folder as Lire

Config.Name: Kavita Comics Library Name
Config.Description: Existing Kavita comics library name

Config.Name: Kavita Comics Root
Config.Description: Comics path as seen inside Kavita; must point to the same host folder as Lire

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public address of Lire, used for reverse proxy detection

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Trusted reverse proxy IP ranges for client IP forwarding

Config.Name: OIDC Issuer
Config.Description: Optional OpenID Connect issuer URL

Config.Name: OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: Optional OpenID Connect client ID

Config.Name: OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional OpenID Connect client secret

Config.Name: OIDC Sign-in Label
Config.Description: Label for the optional single sign-on button

Config.Name: Pocket ID API Key
Config.Description: Optional Pocket ID API key

Config.Name: Indexer Languages
Config.Description: Optional language mapping by Prowlarr indexer ID

Config.Name: Category Languages
Config.Description: Optional language mapping by category ID

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Optional Ollama server URL for synopsis translation

Config.Name: Ollama Model
Config.Description: Optional Ollama model for synopsis translation
